Title: Laptop not powering on
Description: User reports HP EliteBook 840 G7 does not power on when pressing power button. Charging LED is off. Tried different power adapter with no change.
RootCause: Faulty motherboard - no POST on diagnostics
Resolution: Replaced laptop with spare unit from inventory. Old unit sent to vendor for RMA.

Title: Unable to access shared drive \\nexfs01\finance
Description: Finance team unable to access \\nexfs01\finance shared drive. Getting 'Access Denied' error. Multiple users in Finance affected.
RootCause: AD group membership expired after quarterly access review
Resolution: Re-added Finance team members to FIN-SharedDrive AD security group. Verified access restored for all 3 affected users.

Title: Outlook keeps crashing on startup
Description: User reports Outlook 365 crashes immediately after opening. Error: 'Microsoft Outlook has stopped working.' Tried safe mode - same issue.
RootCause: Corrupted Outlook profile due to failed update
Resolution: Created new Outlook profile and reconfigured email account. Old .ost file deleted and mailbox re-synced from Exchange Online.

Title: VPN connection drops every 10 minutes
Description: Engineering team member working from home unable to maintain stable VPN. GlobalProtect client shows 'Gateway timed out' error repeatedly. Impacts code commits and CI/CD access.
RootCause: Under investigation by L2 Network team
Resolution: Initial troubleshooting: reinstalled GlobalProtect client and cleared VPN cache. Issue persists. Escalated.

Title: Printer on 3rd floor not printing
Description: HP LaserJet Pro M404 on 3rd floor shows jobs in queue but nothing prints. Print test page from printer itself works fine.
RootCause: Print spooler service hung on the print server
Resolution: Restarted Print Spooler service on print server NEXPRINT01. Cleared stuck jobs from queue. Printer responding normally.

Title: New joiner cannot log in to domain
Description: New employee Anil Shetty (HR) joining today cannot log in. Account shows as disabled in AD. HR confirms onboarding ticket was raised last week.
RootCause: Account was created but not enabled - onboarding checklist step missed
Resolution: Enabled AD account and set temporary password. Verified user can log in. Reminded HR to verify account status before day-one.

Title: Blue Screen of Death during presentation
Description: Ops Manager's desktop crashed with BSOD (KERNEL_DATA_INPAGE_ERROR) during client presentation in conference room. Critical meeting disrupted.
RootCause: Failing SSD detected via CrystalDiskInfo - reallocated sectors exceeded threshold
Resolution: Swapped SSD with new Samsung 870 EVO from inventory. Restored user profile from last night's backup. Old SSD disposed per asset policy.

Title: Cannot send emails - mailbox full
Description: User reports 'Your mailbox is full' error when trying to send emails. Mailbox at 49.8 GB of 50 GB limit.
RootCause: User never archived old emails. Mailbox at 99.6% capacity.
Resolution: Helped user archive emails older than 1 year to local PST. Mailbox reduced to 31 GB. Configured auto-archive policy for 6-month rotation.

Title: WiFi not connecting in meeting room B
Description: Sales team member cannot connect to NexoraWiFi-5G in meeting room B. Other meeting rooms work fine. 3 other people in the room also affected.
RootCause: Access point in meeting room B rebooted itself after firmware auto-update and failed to rejoin controller
Resolution: Manually rejoined AP to wireless controller. Disabled auto-update on APs - scheduled updates for maintenance window only.

Title: SAP GUI login error - license expired
Description: Finance Manager reports SAP GUI showing 'License expired' error. No Finance users can access SAP. Month-end closing activities blocked.
RootCause: SAP license key renewal was missed by vendor management
Resolution: Confirmed with SAP Basis team that license key expired. Temporary workaround not possible for license issues. Escalated to L2 Apps and vendor.

Title: Monitor flickering intermittently
Description: User reports Dell 24-inch monitor flickers every few minutes. Issue started 2 days ago. Using DisplayPort connection.
RootCause: Loose DisplayPort cable connection at monitor end
Resolution: Reseated DisplayPort cable. Flickering stopped. Monitored for 30 minutes - no recurrence. Advised user to report if issue returns.

Title: Cannot install Adobe Acrobat - admin rights needed
Description: Engineer needs Adobe Acrobat Pro for reviewing technical documentation. Installation fails with 'Administrator privileges required.'
RootCause: Standard user accounts do not have local admin rights per security policy
Resolution: Raised software deployment request via SCCM. Adobe Acrobat Pro pushed to user's machine after manager approval received on 2024-11-11.

Title: Network drive mapping lost after reboot
Description: User reports mapped network drive O: (\\nexfs01\operations) disappears after every reboot. Has to manually remap each morning.
RootCause: GPO for drive mapping not applying - machine was moved to wrong OU in AD
Resolution: Moved computer object to correct OU (Nexora/Workstations/Operations). Ran gpupdate /force. Drive mapping persists after test reboot.

Title: Outlook calendar not syncing with mobile
Description: IT Manager's Outlook calendar on iPhone not showing meetings created on desktop. Last synced 3 days ago per ActiveSync logs.
RootCause: Stale ActiveSync partnership - device not re-authenticating after password change
Resolution: Removed and recreated Exchange ActiveSync device partnership. Reconfigured Outlook app on iPhone. Calendar syncing within 5 minutes of fix.

Title: Multiple users report slow internet
Description: 6 users across Sales and Operations report extremely slow internet. Speedtest shows 2 Mbps down vs normal 200 Mbps. External sites timing out.
RootCause: ISP upstream link degradation confirmed by NOC - fiber splice issue in building MDF
Resolution: Contacted ISP NOC who confirmed fiber issue. ISP dispatched technician. Temporary failover to backup 4G link. Primary restored by ISP at 10:15.

Title: USB keyboard not recognized
Description: Admin assistant reports USB keyboard stopped working. Mouse on same USB hub works fine. Tried different USB port - same issue.
RootCause: Keyboard USB connector physically damaged - bent pin visible on inspection
Resolution: Replaced keyboard from inventory. Tested new keyboard - all keys responsive. Disposed old keyboard per e-waste policy.

Title: Password locked out after 3 failed attempts
Description: Engineer locked out of AD account after entering wrong password. Cannot access any domain resources. Working on deadline for release.
RootCause: Account lockout triggered by 3 failed attempts per security policy (30 min auto-unlock)
Resolution: Manually unlocked AD account after verifying identity via employee ID and manager confirmation. User able to log in immediately.

Title: Zoom meeting audio not working
Description: User reports no audio in Zoom meetings - cannot hear others and others cannot hear him. Headset works fine for music playback.
RootCause: Zoom audio settings pointed to wrong audio device after Windows update changed default
Resolution: Reconfigured Zoom audio settings to use Jabra Evolve 40 headset. Tested in test meeting - audio working both directions. Set device as Windows default.

Title: Laptop overheating and shutting down
Description: Engineer's ThinkPad X1 Carbon shutting down due to overheating during compilation tasks. CPU temps hitting 98°C per HWMonitor. Fan running at max constantly.
RootCause: Suspected dust buildup in cooling system and degraded thermal paste
Resolution: Cleaned air vents with compressed air. Slight improvement but temps still high (92°C under load). Needs internal cleaning and thermal paste replacement. Escalated to L2.

Title: Shared mailbox not receiving external emails
Description: Finance shared mailbox (finance@nexora.com) not receiving emails from external senders since yesterday. Internal emails work fine. 12 expected invoices not received.
RootCause: Exchange transport rule accidentally modified during last maintenance window - external sender filter too restrictive
Resolution: Reviewed Exchange transport rules. Found rule 'External Sender Filter' modified on 2024-11-17 maintenance. Corrected rule condition. Queued external emails delivered within 15 minutes.
